message:
Partial refunds are fixed. `npm test` now passes all 20 tests, including the two in `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js` that were failing.

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The function documents `percent` as 0–100, but it multiplied the amount by it directly, so a 50% refund of 1250 came back as 62500 and a 100% refund came back as 125000. The fix divides by 100:

```js
exports.partialRefund = (payment, percent) => ({ currency: payment.currency, amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

This is the only file changed; `git status` shows just `src/payments/partial-refund.js` modified. I didn't touch any tests or files outside `src/payments`.
